Stop._comment: Stop hooks are informational only — they do not block or gate anything. Command 1 (tsc) surfaces TypeScript errors for awareness after each agent turn; fix them manually if needed. Command 2 (notification) is Windows/PowerShell-specific and will fail silently on macOS/Linux.

hooks.command: [console]::beep(1000, 300); Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms; $n = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.NotifyIcon; $n.Icon = [System.Drawing.SystemIcons]::Information; $n.Visible = $true; $n.ShowBalloonTip(5000, 'Claude Code', 'Claude code xong rồi master', [System.Windows.Forms.ToolTipIcon]::Info); Start-Sleep 5; $n.Dispose()
